name: Ramblers over a Winding Stream
dimensions: Painting only: 24.5 x 25.2 cm (9 5/8 x 9 15/16 in.)
summary: This album leaf is one of few surviving paintings by Luo Zichuan. During the Yuan dynasty, the Luo family of painters in Jiangxi province, in Southern China, had a network of patrons extending their reputation all the way to the capital city of Beijing.
